name: ploff-webos
description: Development checks for Ploff for Plex on LG webOS

scripts.check:coordinator: for file in app/coordinator/*.js; do node --check "$file" || exit 1; done
scripts.lint: eslint app scripts tests webos-service eslint.config.js
scripts.test:unit: for test in tests/test-*.js; do node "$test" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:pre-release: npm run verify && npm run test:memory
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:baseline
scripts.verify: npm run check:styles && npm run check:app-bundle && npm run check:release-metadata && npm run check:coordinator && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:feature-contracts && npm run check:performance && npm run check:es5 && npm run lint && npm run typecheck:contracts && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:assets && npm run check:lg-ux
